data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the same order (book with miles, origin, destination, depart date picker, Find flights, pick a fare) and adds traveler/cabin steps and a trip_type-like detail that the true trace only partly shows. It lacks an explicit trip_type parameter and its date and traveler steps are somewhat vague, but a browser automation could still be built from it.
